The '''Jagged Plains''' was the crystal-strewn plain that made up most of the eastern [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The Jagged Plains was bordered on its north edge by the [[Buried Field]], and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] maintained [[Jagged Plains Republic Outpost]] on the western edge of the area. The [[Kintan crusher]] [[Gargath]] lived in the area known as [[Gargath's Watch]] on the plains.
